hypotheses.title: Time-to-start market structure
hypotheses.claim: Spread, trading intensity, and two-sided availability change systematically as start time approaches.
hypotheses.h0: Conditional on market class and price band, market structure does not vary with time-to-start.
hypotheses.h1: At least one frozen time-to-start bucket has a pre-specified, repeatable market-structure difference.
hypotheses.population: Pregame Basketball, Tennis, and Baseball markets, separated by market type.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Median quoted spread by frozen time-to-start bucket.

hypotheses.title: Event-arrival clustering
hypotheses.claim: Book updates and trades arrive in repeatable bursts whose time scale differs by sport and market type.
hypotheses.h0: Frozen burst statistics are indistinguishable from the selected independent-arrival baseline.
hypotheses.h1: Frozen burst statistics exceed the baseline by a pre-specified amount in held-out events.
hypotheses.population: Basketball, Tennis, and Baseball receive-clock event streams.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Burst frequency and duration under a frozen inter-arrival rule.

hypotheses.title: Post-burst adverse markout
hypotheses.claim: Maker-side markout worsens after a frozen burst or toxicity state.
hypotheses.h0: Conditional maker-side markout is no worse after the frozen state than outside it.
hypotheses.h1: Post-state maker-side markout is worse by at least the frozen minimum effect.
hypotheses.population: Eligible Basketball, Tennis, and Baseball markets with valid synchronized quotes and trades.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Maker-side executable markout at frozen horizons.

hypotheses.title: Spread-shock resilience
hypotheses.claim: Spread shocks have sport- and state-dependent recovery times, and some accompany persistent price moves.
hypotheses.h0: Recovery time and permanent price response do not differ across frozen states.
hypotheses.h1: At least one frozen state has a repeatable difference exceeding the minimum effect.
hypotheses.population: Basketball, Tennis, and Baseball markets with continuous valid L1 coverage.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Time to recover a frozen fraction of the pre-shock spread.

hypotheses.title: Signed-flow continuation versus reversal
hypotheses.claim: Frozen signed trade-flow states predict short-horizon continuation or reversal in selected market regimes.
hypotheses.h0: Future price change is conditionally independent of the frozen signed-flow state.
hypotheses.h1: The state predicts a pre-specified directional effect that repeats on held-out events.
hypotheses.population: Basketball, Tennis, and Baseball markets with defensible trade-side classification.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Signed future executable midpoint change at frozen horizons.

hypotheses.title: Cost-clearing maker windows
hypotheses.claim: Some recurring states offer quoted spread greater than expected adverse selection, fees, latency loss, and exit cost.
hypotheses.h0: Net expected maker edge is not positive after all frozen costs in any eligible state.
hypotheses.h1: At least one pre-specified state has positive held-out net expected maker edge above the minimum threshold.
hypotheses.population: Pre-specified Basketball, Tennis, and Baseball maker-eligible market states.
hypotheses.primary_outcome: Per-opportunity net expected maker edge after frozen costs.
